summary: Rizal 3rd District representative with 17 principal-authored bills. Authored an anti-dynasty ban. Co-authored the national minimum wage, an alcohol excise increase and a second anti-dynasty bill.
caveat: Economic score rests only on co-authored bills; anti-dynasty is a single institutional issue and is unscored.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Co-authored national minimum wage (-2) and an alcohol excise increase (-1, sin tax). Both co-authored; no authored economic bills.
